sourcePolicy.ordinary: Authenticated native P1 original episodes, P4 derivations and P5 interface histories in a caller-declared, fully enumerated Work universe. Synthetic disposable data only in this session.
sourcePolicy.protected: Only authenticated complete owner preimages through the reviewed S6/S8 consumer port. Current cut has no complete protected analytical-episode port; do not relabel ordinary history.
sourcePolicy.trainingConsent: No external customer/user data ingested, uploaded or used for model training.
sourcePolicy.selection: Retain every request, status, failed/declined/incomplete/unknown attempt and correction within selected original episodes.
sourcePolicy.knowledge: Explicit cut; visible immutable records separated from later knowledge/adverse notices. Future outputs never select an abstraction.
sourcePolicy.secrets: No credentials, tokens, production connections or sealed evaluation content in capsule bytes, logs or commits.
